motivation: Ordinary English competence does not imply independent access to academic mathematical-logic prose, especially for English L2 readers and readers without the assumed academic register or prerequisites.
not: a replacement for the standard scholarly English edition
a claim that a new language translation exists
a file-format conversion counted as register translation
a completed or publicly released edition
initial_work: Review corpus-specific sociolinguistic, applied-linguistic, plain-language, controlled-language, readability and technical-translation evidence.
Construct representative source-aligned OpenLogic tests before corpus-wide rewriting.
Record failure modes and deterministic semantic QA for definitions, quantifiers, logical scope, notation, cross-references and proof validity.
Test explicit definitions, prerequisite repair, short worked examples and feedback where the source structure permits.
Keep screen-reader HTML and MathML, mobile reflow and offline delivery as access requirements distinct from the register translation itself.
